# Divider

A thin line between groups of content.

- Status: implemented
- Category: container
- Pattern: HTML `<hr> (thematic) or a border`

## Anatomy

- **line**: border.subtle, 1 px.

## Variants

- `horizontal`:
- `vertical`: Between inline items.

## States

- `default`

## Accessibility

- Role: separator (hr) or none
- Decorative lines are borders, not hr.

WCAG 2.2 success criteria:

- 1.3.1 Info and Relationships (A)

## Tokens

| Token | CSS custom property |
| --- | --- |
| `divider.color` | `--divider-color` |
| `divider.width` | `--divider-width` |

## Platforms

| Platform | Implementation |
| --- | --- |
| web | hr.nd-divider |
| ios | Divider |
| android | HorizontalDivider |
| flutter | Divider |

Web: `.nd-divider` in kit.css; modifiers `.nd-divider--vertical`.

## Web example

From the reference page:

```html
<p>Above the line.</p>
<hr class="nd-divider" />
<p>Below the line.</p>
<div class="nd-cluster">
  <span>Summary</span>
  <span class="nd-divider nd-divider--vertical" aria-hidden="true"></span>
  <span>Details</span>
</div>
```
